verses.text: Of David. To You, O YHWH, I call out. O my Rock, do not be deaf to me, lest You be silent to me and I be likened with those descending to the Pit.

segments.text: Of David. To You, O YHWH, I call out. O my Rock, do not be deaf to me, lest You be silent to me and I be likened with those descending to the Pit.

verses.text: May You hear the voice of my supplications, in my crying out to You, in my lifting up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

segments.text: May You hear the voice of my supplications, in my crying out to You, in my lifting up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

verses.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, those speaking peace with their neighbors, and evil [is] in their heart.

segments.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, those speaking peace with their neighbors, and evil [is] in their heart.

verses.text: Give to them according to their doing, and according to the evil of their deeds! According to the work of their hands, give to them; return their dealing to them!

segments.text: Give to them according to their doing, and according to the evil of their deeds! According to the work of their hands, give to them; return their dealing to them!

verses.text: For they do not have regard toward the works of YHWH, and toward the deed of His hands; He shall overthrow them, and not rebuild them.

segments.text: For they do not have regard toward the works of YHWH, and toward the deed of His hands; He shall overthrow them, and not rebuild them.

verses.text: Blessed [be] YHWH, for He has heard the voice of my supplications.

segments.text: Blessed [be] YHWH, for He has heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.text: YHWH [is] my strength and my shield; in Him my heart trusts, and I am helped; so my heart rejoices, and with my song I will give thanks to Him.

segments.text: YHWH [is] my strength and my shield; in Him my heart trusts, and I am helped; so my heart rejoices, and with my song I will give thanks to Him.

verses.text: YHWH [is] the strength for them; and He [is] a stronghold of salvation [for] His anointed.

segments.text: YHWH [is] the strength for them; and He [is] a stronghold of salvation [for] His anointed.

verses.text: May You save Your people and bless Your inheritance, and shepherd them and carry them, even to forever.

segments.text: May You save Your people and bless Your inheritance, and shepherd them and carry them, even to forever.
